blocks.text: Pickup is a cross-platform application that brings together users searching for casual, non-competitive 'pick-up' sports games hosted at both free-to-use public venues (public basketball courts, padel courts, parks, town squares) and privately owned venues (tennis clubs, venues that require an external booking, golf courses, 5-a-side pitches, private tennis and basketball courts etc).

I am trying to appeal to people interested in picking up a sport for the first time. It can be difficult and even counter-productive to start in a more formal environment when trying something new. Sports clubs can be expensive and daunting to join, and private lessons are often prohibitably expensive as a first step. I want to remove that barrier, to encourage community outside the closed-garden of traditional sports clubs, and to make casually playing a sport a truly good experience.

Users will download and sign up to pickup. They will be able to create matches at a venue, specify values such as a start time and how long they would like to play for, skill level, languages spoken, age ranges, competitiveness, availability to teach players how to play, and then push the match 'live'. Other users on the app interested in playing casual sports will be presented with these matches and will subsequently register for a particular session.

Overall, the intention is to make playing organised sport a fun, safe, and seamless experience for everyone. It is not a place for competitiveness for the sake of competitiveness, but it is the place for a kickabout, a knock-up, or a pickup!
